name: Clariana de Cardener (Spain)
description: Red field charged with ten white five-pointed stars arranged vertically in three columns of 3, 4 and 3.
history: The official flag of Clariana de Cardener is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, red, with the ten white five-pointed stars of the arms placed vertically and staggered, 3, 4 and 3, the whole 19/24 of the height of the cloth; approved on 17 June 2011 and published in the DOGC on 28 June 2011.

features.role: ten stars in three columns of 3, 4 and 3
